notes.title: Changelog 2.0.0
notes.content:
First, we want to thank everybody for their support! Its been an exciting first month and we are happy to release version 2.0!

3 New Brands, 10 New Cars: 
Fundai to compete with Yotoya
Hevy middle of the pack brand
Innie to compete with GEW

New Brand Market Share: 
Yotoya: 20% Fundai: 19% 
Dub: 15% Vord: 13% Hevy: 12% 
GEW: 9% Innie: 8% 
Leanza: 4%

2 more Special Characters: Including the Inspector!

More NPC’s

New lot size for 200 cars

Increase used car lot to 36

Bug fix - Owned dealers CSR can go above 100 and below 0
Bug fix – Customers still came in when you didn’t own a license

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.5.0 & 1.1.4.0
notes.content:
Changelog 1.1.5.0
•	Bug fix – offered trade-ins when the used car license is not owned
•	Bug fix – used cars would still come in for service without owning used car license

Changelog 1.1.4.0
•	Bug fix – Finance screen, NPC dealers for purchase are never created
•	Reduced how fast the Zelp page scrolls
•	Zelp feedback added for special characters
•	The quality of new hires is now based on your CSR

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.3.0
notes.content:
Changelog 1.1.3.0
•	Small visual changes
•	Zelp scrolling = page up/page down

Changelog 1.1.0.0
•	Game Ending, 250 turns = Dealer Worth, as well as a side objective of $1 million dollars = turns.
•	Zelp is now live! Check your daily reviews on Zelp! Customer Feedback and Reviews, aka Logs!
•	3 Day weather forecast, presented by Zelp
•	CSR will not go below 0 now
•	New game starting option, start with just cash.

notes.title: Changelog 1.0.10.0
notes.content:
Changelog 1.0.10.0
•	Bug fixed – car stopping point in the garage

Changelog 1.0.9.0
•	Bug fixed – Pink Lady/Man in the White Hat sometimes caused game to crash
•	Bug fixed - trade-ins popped up when the used car lot was full
•	Enable screenshots F12
•	Increased game speed, there is a 3 step fast forward now
•	Added switch to full screen throughout the game
•	Will no longer lose a CSR point on a no sale when playing on Easy. Hard will remain as it was.
